notes: Exact web/app/db tier membership and the NAT-in-the-same-AZ pairing are not checked: tiers are not distinguishable by attributes, and the subnet->route table->route->NAT chain is longer than one relationship. They are approximated: nine associations use exactly seven route tables (one shared web table), six route tables carry NAT default routes, and the NAT routes use all three NAT gateways. 'Carved out of the VPC's range' (subnet CIDR inside the VPC CIDR) is not expressible. Candidate review (5 templates): all pass every core check.
